name: Teller Trainee
blurb: Count cash, open accounts and watch how the bank judges small businesses.

perk.desc: Nexus Bank waives your overdraft fees while you work there.

lines: Your drawer balances to the cent. Sofia pretends not to be impressed.
A bakery owner asks for a loan. Sofia asks for three months of books. You see why.
You learn the difference between revenue and cash, the hard way, on someone else's account.
Quiet morning. You read the small-business lending policy twice.
